footprints.description: Amphenol FCI C04 8-contact smart-card contact module, through-hole right angle, 8 pins + 2 pegs
footprints.note: VRW11376.pdf p.1 (drawing VRW11376 rev F) IMPLANTATION C.I PCB FOOTPRINT: 8 holes d1 (x8) in two rows of 4 at 2.54 pitch (2.54 x 3), rows 38.1 apart (19.05 each side of the peg line); 2 peg holes d2.2 +0.1 on the peg line 27.16 apart; first hole of each row 4.69 from the left peg. Origin = peg-line mid point: peg x = +-27.16/2 = +-13.58, row y = +-38.1/2 = +-19.05, hole x = -13.58+4.69 = -8.89, then +2.54 each (-6.35, -3.81, -1.27). Body = top-view housing 40 x 31.16 (rotated to match the drawing: 31.16 wide, 40 high), centred on the peg line mid point (the printed outline is a little larger, about 32 x 42, not dimensioned). Pad diameter is not printed: drill 1.0 + 0.6 = 1.6 (assumed). The drawing does not number the holes: pins 1-4 = the top row left to right, 5-8 = the bottom row left to right (assumed, ISO 7816 C1..C8 order). The peg holes are drawn non-plated (assumed). A contact module: no card entry direction.

footprints.description: Amphenol FCI E02 8-contact smart-card connector, surface mount, 8 contacts + 2 detect pads + 2 fixing holes
footprints.note: 10128659.pdf p.1 (drawing 10128659 rev B) Recommended PCB Layout (Component side), card insertion down: pads 1.2 x 2.0 (2 and 1.2 printed); top row of 4 at 2.54 pitch (7.62 first to last), bottom row of 4 under it plus two detect pads 7.62 and 5.08 further left; rows 44 apart over the pad outer edges (pad centres 44-2 = 42 apart). Origin = right fixing hole at x 0: the 4 pads end 13.93 left of it, x = -13.93-7.62 = -21.55, -19.01, -16.47, -13.93; extra pads -21.55-7.62 = -29.17 and -29.17-5.08 = -34.25; holes 2x d1.7 +0.05 (optional fixing) 41.5 apart, left one 12 and right one 12+22 = 34 below the top pad edge, pad centres 1.0 and 43.0 (2.0/2 from the edges, 44-1). Body = housing 55.5 (7 + 41.5 + 7 from the top view, the hole to housing edge 7 is printed) x 40 (+0.3), centre x = pad 1 + 0.8 (the printed 0.8 to the dashed centre line) = -20.75, y from 2 to 42 (the top view puts the right hole 10 below the housing top edge: 12-10 = 2, and the bottom edge at 2+40 = 42). The pads are not numbered on the drawing: pins 1-4 = top row left to right, 5-8 = bottom row left to right, 9 and 10 = the detect pads left to right (assumed). The drawing is shown mirrored against the top view of the connector (checked by the hole and detect-pad positions); the recommended layout is used as printed. The two big crossed circles in the layout are not dimensioned and are not drawn.

footprints.description: Amphenol FCI E05 8-contact smart-card connector, through-hole right angle, 8 contacts + 2 detect pins
footprints.note: VJW53908.pdf p.1 (drawing VJW53908 rev F) Recommended PCB Layout (Component side), card insertion down: 8 holes d1 +0.1 (x8) in two rows of 4 at 2.54 pitch (7.62 span, first hole of both rows on the same line), rows 38.1 apart; 2 holes d1 +0.1 (x2) 5.08 apart whose nearer one is 7.62 left of the row line. Origin = first hole of the top row: bottom row y = 38.1; detect holes x = -7.62 and -7.62-5.08 = -12.7. The detect holes sit a little above the bottom row line: the offset is a dimension with no value on the print, scaled as 1.1 (y = 38.1-1.1 = 37.0, approximate). Pad diameter not printed: drill 1.0 + 0.6 = 1.6 (assumed). Body = housing 55.5 +0.3 wide x 60 high (the 20 front part plus the 40 +0.3 section, sheet 1 top view), read at scale from the top view: the first hole row lies about 19.9 from the housing left edge and the top view is the mirror of the layout, so the centre x = 3.81 (middle of the 4 holes) - 2.5 (group offset from the housing centre) = 1.3; the 40 section runs from y -0.4 to 39.6 and the 20 front part from -20.4 to -0.4: centre (1.3, 9.6). Housing position is approximate (about 0.5 mm). Pins are not numbered on the drawing: 1-4 = top row left to right, 5-8 = bottom row, 9 and 10 = the detect holes left to right (assumed).

footprints.description: Amphenol FCI L26 sliding-contact smart-card connector (ISO, 8 contacts), through-hole right angle, 8 contacts + 2 detect pins + 4 pegs
footprints.note: VJW54701.pdf p.2 (drawing VJW_54701 rev G; VJW_54705, the F05 variant, has the same pattern) RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT, CONTACT CONFIGURATION: ISO (CONNECTOR SIDE) with the AFNOR layout of the same sheet for the dimensions: holes d1 +0.1 (10 holes, labelled C1 C2 C3 C4 / S1 S2 / C5 C6 C7 C8), contact pitch 2.54 (7x2.54 = 17.78), first hole 11.96 right of the left peg; 4 peg holes d3.2 +0.1 58 apart (x) and 20 apart (y); top contact row 9.05 above the upper peg line, bottom row 38.1 below the top row; detect holes S1, S2 3.81 right of C4, 2.54 apart (S1 on the row line). Origin = the right upper peg: C1..C4 and C5..C8 x = -58+11.96+2.54*k for k = 4..7 = -35.88, -33.34, -30.80, -28.26 (the ISO layout keeps the right four positions of the AFNOR row, checked by the sheet at scale: 258 px / 7.14 px per mm = 36.1); S x = -28.26+3.81 = -24.45; rows y = -9.05 and -9.05+38.1 = 29.05. Drawn with the card insertion arrow pointing up, so the opening is at the bottom: rotated 180 degrees about the housing centre (-29, 10), the dashed centre lines. Body = 62 x 40 (sheet 1). Pad diameter not printed: drill 1.0 + 0.6 = 1.6 (assumed); the pegs are drawn non-plated (assumed).

footprints.description: Amphenol FCI P02 8-contact chip-card connector with cover, surface mount, 8 contacts + 2 detect pads + 2 pegs
footprints.note: VJW53666.pdf p.2 (drawing VJW53666 rev L) PCB LAYOUT (RECOMMENDED): pads 1.2 wide (C1..C4 / C5..C8) and 1.9 tall, pitch 2.54 (7.62 first to last), the two rows 26 apart over the outer pad edges (centres 26-1.9 = 24.1); detect pads 1.4 x 1.9 5.08 and 7.62 right of C4, their lower edge 8.2 below the top row edge (centre 8.2-0.95 = 7.25); 2 holes d2.1 +0.1 44.45 apart in x, 20.32 apart in y, the right one 2.84 below the top pad edge. Origin: x = C4 centre, y = top pad edge; C1..C4 x = -7.62, -5.08, -2.54, 0; right hole x = 22.86 (printed), left = 22.86-44.45 = -21.59; hole y 2.84 and 2.84+20.32 = 23.16. The sheet shows this layout mirrored in x against the connector-side keep-out view (not labelled which side the layout is seen from): the layout is used as printed, the housing offset below is mirrored from the keep-out view. Body = keep-out outline 57.8 x 33.68, left edge 5.24 outside the left hole, top 6.6 above the top pad edge (scaled), x centre -0.8, y centre 10.24 in the layout frame. The card moves up the sheet (stop at the top): the opening is at the bottom, rotated 180 degrees about the body centre. C1..C8 are labelled, S1 / S2 are not (S1 = the pad nearer C4, assumed). Pegs d2.0 (2x, side view) in d2.1 holes, drawn non-plated (assumed).

footprints.description: Amphenol FCI S07 micro-SIM card reader, surface mount, 8 contacts + 2 detect pads
footprints.note: VJW53696.pdf p.1 (drawing VJW53696 rev H) PCB Layout (scale 3:1): two columns of 4 pads 1.8 x 1.4 at 2.54 pitch, the columns 26 apart over the outer pad edges (centres 26-1.8 = 24.2); two detect pads 1.8 x 1.6, 2.54 apart, the lower one 3.81 above the first pad row, their right edge 17.78 left of the right column outer edge. Origin: x = right column outer edge, y = first pad row; right column x = -1.8/2 = -0.9, left column x = -26+0.9 = -25.1, rows y = 0, 2.54, 5.08, 7.62; detect pads x = -17.78-0.9 = -18.68, y = -3.81 and -3.81-2.54 = -6.35. Body = housing 29.45 x 17.45 (printed); the layout outline scaled: right edge 2.2 inside the right column, top 8.0 above the first row (so the body spans x -31.65 .. -2.2, y -8.0 .. 9.45; approximate to about 0.3). The card stops at the left of the sheet (Mechanical Stop), the opening is on the right: rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise (right to up) about the body centre. The pads are not numbered on the drawing: pins 1-4 = the left column top to bottom, 5-8 = the right column top to bottom, 9 / 10 = the detect pads top to bottom (assumed).

footprints.description: Amphenol FCI S07 micro-SIM card reader (SCM 1.5 mm), surface mount, 8 contacts + 2 detect pads
footprints.note: VJW54719.pdf p.2 (drawing VJW54719 rev G) PCB RECOMMENDED LAYOUT (CONNECTOR SIDE), card insertion arrow to the left: two columns of 4 pads at 2.54 pitch (7.62 span), the columns 27.2 apart over the outer pad edges (printed; the drawn geometry scales to 26.1, the sheet disagrees with itself, the printed value is used and the left column is 1.2 further left than on VJW53696), pad size 1.8 x 1.4 (scaled from the 1.4 printed height; width by the scale, same as VJW53696), detect pads 1.8 x 1.6, 2.54 apart, the lower one 3.81 above the first row, their right edge 17.78 left of the right column outer edge. Origin: right column outer edge, first row: right column x = -0.9, left column x = -27.2+0.9 = -26.3, rows y = 0, 2.54, 5.08, 7.62; detect pads x = -18.68, y = -6.35 and -3.81. Body = housing 29.45 x 17.45 (sheet 1 top view), right edge 2.1 inside the right column and top 8.2 above the first row (scaled, approximate). The card opening is on the right: rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise about the body centre. Pins are not numbered: 1-4 = left column top to bottom, 5-8 = right column top to bottom, 9 / 10 = detect pads top to bottom (assumed).

footprints.description: Amphenol GSD 7.0 SD Express card socket (GSD21001X7BHR), surface mount, 21 contacts + 4 shell pads + 2 holes
footprints.note: GSD21001X7BHR.pdf p.2 (drawing GSD21001X7BHR rev AX7) RECOMMEND PC BOARD LAYOUT: 21 pads 0.65 x 1.25 (21-0.65, 1.25) at offsets from the centre line (pin 1 right, pin 21 left): 11.10, 9.85, 8.60, 7.35, 6.10, 4.85, 3.60, 2.35, 1.30, 0.25, -0.80, -1.85, -2.90, -3.95, -5.15, -6.40, -7.60, -8.70, -9.80, -10.90, -12.00 (all printed); 2 NPTH d1.75 22.80 apart (+-11.40), 3.64 below the pad top edge; 4 GND pads 1.80 x 2.00 (4-1.80, 4-2.00) 29.25 apart (+-14.625), at 3.80 and 23.90 below the hole line (y = 3.64+3.80 = 7.44 and 3.64+23.90 = 27.54). Origin x = centre line, y = pad top edge; pad centre y = 1.25/2 = 0.625. Body = housing 28.35 x 29.40 REF (sheet 1) = the dashed outline of the layout, top edge 2.04 below the pad top edge (scaled), y centre 2.04+14.7 = 16.74. The opening (card scoop) is at the bottom of the layout: rotated 180 degrees about the body centre. Pin names 1..21 are the sheet 2 table (pin 1 = VSS3 ... 21 = WP); the 4 GND pads are the shield pin 22.

footprints.description: GCT MEM1052 push-push SD card socket, surface mount, 9 contacts + WP + CD + 2 cover-ground pads + 2 holes
footprints.note: MEM1052.pdf p.2 (GCT MEM1052 rev A, 30 May 2025) Recommended PCB Layout, as viewed from component side: 11 pads 1.00 wide (11x 1.00) x 1.50 tall; centre to centre WP-P8 3.35, P8-P7 1.70, P7-P6 2.42, P6-P5 2.50, P5-P4 2.50, P4-P3 1.70, P3-CD 1.65, CD-P2 1.65, P2-P1 2.50, P1-P9 2.50. Origin x = connector centre line (12.10 from each hole): WP is 13.16 left of it (scaled: P4 12.47 from WP + 0.69 to the line; not printed), so x = -13.16, -9.81, -8.11, -5.69, -3.19, -0.69, 1.01, 2.66, 4.31, 6.81, 9.31; y origin = pad bottom edge, pad centre y = -1.5/2 = -0.75. 2 holes d1.50 24.20 apart (+-12.10) 23.55 below; cover-ground pads 1.20 x 2.00 (2x 1.20, 2x 2.00): left centre 1.50 left of the left hole = -13.60, 2.10 above the hole line (y 21.45); right one 28.00 from the left one = 14.40, 3.30 above the hole line (y 20.25). Body = 28.48 x 28.80 (the layout outline 28.80 long from the pad edge), x centre 0.39 (left edge scaled at -13.85, width 28.48), y centre 14.4. The card scoop is at the bottom of the layout: rotated 180 degrees about the body centre. Pins: P1..P9 as the table (pin 1 = CD/DAT3 ... 9 = DAT2), 10 = WP, 11 = CD, 12 = the cover-ground pads.

footprints.description: Same Sky MSD-1-A push-in micro SD card socket, surface mount, 8 contacts + card detect + 4 shell pads + 2 holes
footprints.note: msd-1-a.pdf p.3 (Same Sky MSD-1-A, 11/01/2024) Recommended PCB Layout, top view: 9 pads 0.70 x 1.60 at 1.10 pitch (8*1.10 = 8.80, Cd to pad 1), Cd 6.55 left of the connector centre line (6.55 printed), so x = -6.55, -5.45, -4.35, -3.25, -2.15, -1.05, 0.05, 1.15, 2.25 for Cd, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 (pad 3 is 0.05 right of the line); y origin = pad bottom edge, pad centre -0.8. Shell pads: upper left 1.20 x 1.80 with its right edge 0.60 left of the Cd pad centre (-6.55-0.60 = -7.15, centre -7.15-0.60 = -7.75), y spans -0.40 .. 1.40 (10.20-8.80 = 1.40 lower edge, 1.80 tall); upper right 1.60 x 1.50, x 6.05 .. 7.65 (scaled), y spans -0.50 .. 1.00 (10.20-9.20 = 1.00 lower edge, 1.50 tall); two lower 1.20 x 2.20 pads on the y = 10.20 line, inner edges 14.30 apart (centres +-(7.15+0.60) = +-7.75); 2 holes d1.00 8.00 apart, the left one 4.95 left of the line (-4.95 and +3.05) on y = 10.20. Body = 14.85 x 14.50 (page 2), centred on the connector line, top edge 0.6 above the pad bottom edge-line (pad tails 1.0 outside the body: -1.6+1.0 = -0.6), y centre -0.6+7.25 = 6.65. The card enters from the bottom of the layout: rotated 180 degrees about the body centre. The holes are drawn non-plated (assumed). Pins: 1..8 as the table, 9 = the Cd switch pad, 10 = the four shell (GND) pads.
